infobox.usage: Unlocks door 303 in the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 303 key (Dorm 303) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "303" on it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Golden Swag
- 1 needs to be found for the quest Aid Stations

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

- In the Tigr vehicle next to the military checkpoint (Scav Checkpoint extraction).

- Warehouse #6 next to the fuel silos, in the northern part of the second floor in a hanging tool cabinet.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Wooden crate
- Loose loot (Weapons)
- Possible Rare weapon spawn (HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle or FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle)

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text:
